articles.titleCn: 参数化知识图谱记忆中的存储-检索差距
articles.abstractCn: 图检索增强生成将检索到的子图在查询时放入模型的上下文窗口中，每次调用都会产生持续性的token成本并暴露源数据。我们研究了一种替代方案：将知识图谱离线编译成一组LoRA适配器，每个实体一个，作为可通过注入权重而非文本进行查询的参数化知识层，且查询时无上下文成本。在MetaQA数据集上，我们发现子图训练的适配器编码了无上下文的事实性知识，并能泛化到未见过的问句：对于单值关系，适配器比近乎无法做闭卷问答的基模型（0.007）高出+0.243的精确匹配分数，只有正确的适配器能恢复这些知识（比基模型高出+0.283的预言者差距）。然而，存储的知识无法通过相似性恢复：对于无子图的查询，基于嵌入和权重空间几何的检索均表现随机，因为语义邻近实体的适配器不包含答案——知识存储在本地且无法迁移。权重几何与子图语义相关（ρ=+0.329），但与功能检索无关。我们量化了字节和上下文token成本，并与图检索增强生成进行了对比，并讨论了部署影响。我们的结果表明参数化知识图谱内存可行用于存储知识，并识别出通过非语义相似性机制选择和组合适配器是核心开放问题——这促使我们提出一种学习型、查询条件化的组合机制。

articles.title: ReliableRAG: Combating Misinformation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Reliability-Guided Reasoning Chains
articles.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful architecture for Question Answering (QA) by integrating external information into Large Language Models (LLMs). However, false, inaccurate, and misleading information in news and social media poses a serious challenge to real-world RAG systems, especially in multi-hop QA, where complex multi-step reasoning can be misled by even a single deceptive misinformation segment in the retrieved documents. Existing approaches mainly rely on implicit alignment or explicit regulation, but their limited ability to assess fine-grained information reliability makes them vulnerable to deceptive misinformation that is semantically relevant to the question yet factually incorrect, leading to erroneous answers. To address this limitation, we propose ReliableRAG, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first reliability-driven framework that mitigates deceptive misinformation in multi-hop QA through fine-grained evaluation of individual triples. ReliableRAG first extracts information segments from source documents and represents them as structured triples. It then quantifies triple reliability by combining query-triple semantic relevance with triple credibility, retaining only the top-$K$ reliable and non-redundant triples. Based on these refined triples, ReliableRAG autoregressively constructs robust reasoning chains to consolidate trustworthy evidence and filter deceptive misinformation, producing accurate answers faithful to reliable information. Experiments on three multi-hop QA datasets show that ReliableRAG outperforms existing methods, substantially improving the factual reliability and robustness of RAG systems under deceptive misinformation injection.
articles.titleCn: 可靠RAG：通过可靠性引导推理链对抗检索增强生成中的虚假信息
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将外部信息整合到大型语言模型（LLM）中，已成为问答（QA）领域的一种强大架构。然而，新闻和社交媒体中的虚假、不准确和误导性信息对现实世界的RAG系统构成了严峻挑战，尤其是在多跳问答中，复杂的推理过程可能被检索到的文档中单个欺骗性错误信息片段所误导。现有方法主要依赖隐式对齐或显式调控，但由于其评估细粒度信息可靠性的能力有限，它们容易受到与问题语义相关但事实错误的欺骗性错误信息的攻击，从而导致错误答案。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了可靠RAG（ReliableRAG），据我们所知，这是首个通过细粒度评估单个三元组来减轻多跳问答中欺骗性错误信息影响的可靠性驱动框架。可靠RAG首先从源文档中提取信息片段，并将其表示为结构化的三元组。然后，它通过结合查询-三元组的语义相关性和三元组的可信度来量化三元组的可靠性，仅保留前K个可靠且非冗余的三元组。基于这些精炼的三元组，可靠RAG自回归地构建鲁棒的推理链，以巩固可信证据并过滤欺骗性错误信息，从而生成忠实于可靠信息的准确答案。在三个多跳问答数据集上的实验表明，可靠RAG优于现有方法，在欺骗性错误信息注入的情况下，显著提高了RAG系统的事实可靠性和鲁棒性。

articles.title: PonsRAG: A Pons-Inspired RAG Bridging Cognitive Islands for Coordinated Long Narrative Reasoning
articles.abstract: Long Narrative Reasoning is an essential capability for processing and reasoning over complex narratives. While retrieval-augmented generation provides a promising framework, existing methods still face two critical challenges: cognitive islanding and cross-layer evidence disconnection. To address these issues, we propose PonsRAG, a coordinated RAG framework inspired by the biological pons. PonsRAG consists of two key components: Triple-Layer Indexing, which organizes documents into a connected knowledge structure to bridge cognitive islands, and Coordinated Reasoning, which retrieves evidence across distinct layers and integrates cross-layer information into a unified context. We evaluate PonsRAG on four long-context narrative benchmarks, and experimental results show that it outperforms the strongest baseline, achieving a 11.56% relative improvement in average accuracy on multi-choice tasks.
articles.titleCn: 灵感源于庞斯的RAG：连接认知孤岛以实现协同长叙事推理的庞斯式RAG
articles.abstractCn: 长叙事推理是处理和推理复杂叙事的关键能力。虽然检索增强生成提供了一个有前景的框架，但现有方法仍面临两个关键挑战：认知孤岛和跨层证据断开连接。为解决这些问题，我们提出了受生物学脑桥启发的协同RAG框架PonsRAG。PonsRAG包含两个关键组件：三层索引，它将文档组织成一个连接的知识结构以连接认知孤岛，以及协同推理，它跨不同层级检索证据并将跨层信息整合到一个统一的上下文中。我们在四个长上下文叙事基准上评估了PonsRAG，实验结果表明它优于最强的基线，在多选题任务上平均准确率提升了11.56%。

articles.title: VietAIDetector: An Open-Source Zero-Shot Detector for Vietnamese AI-Generated Text
articles.abstract: In recent years, distinguishing between AI-generated text and human-written text has remained a challenge. In this paper, we introduce VietAIDetector, an open-source tool designed specifically for detecting Vietnamese AI-generated text. It allows users to interact through a Gradio web interface with inputs ranging from raw Vietnamese text to common text file formats, including scanned documents and exceptionally long texts that exceed the context size of the employed Large Language Models (LLMs). The core component of the tool employs a Zero-Shot approach to detect AI-generated text without requiring domain-specific training data, building upon the previous VietBinoculars and Binoculars research. The tool is built upon a Vietnamese-specific language model and has been evaluated on out-of-domain datasets, demonstrating superior performance compared to existing methods primarily developed for English. Additionally, users can select optimal detection thresholds based on F1 score, accuracy, or TPR@0.05FPR requirements. The results are presented through the web interface, allowing users to easily review and verify suspicious texts or download them as a PDF report. The tool is publicly available at https://github.com/trieuntu/VietAIDetector
articles.titleCn: 越南AI文本开源零样本检测器：VietAIDetector
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，区分AI生成的文本与人类撰写的文本一直是一项挑战。在本文中，我们介绍了VietAIDetector，这是一个专门用于检测越南语AI生成文本的开源工具。它允许用户通过Gradio网页界面进行交互，输入范围从原始越南语文本到常见的文本文件格式，包括扫描文档以及超出所使用的大型语言模型（LLMs）上下文大小的异常长文本。该工具的核心组件采用零样本方法检测AI生成的文本，无需特定领域的训练数据，基于先前VietBinoculars和Binoculars的研究。该工具基于特定的越南语言模型构建，并在领域外数据集上进行了评估，与主要为英语开发现有方法相比，表现出更优越的性能。此外，用户可以根据F1分数、准确率或TPR@0.05FPR要求选择最佳检测阈值。结果通过网页界面呈现，允许用户轻松审查和验证可疑文本或将其下载为PDF报告。该工具可在https://github.com/trieuntu/VietAIDetector公开获取。

articles.title: MathAdv: What Theorem Provers Know, Reason, Formalize, and Generalize
articles.abstract: Formal theorem proving enables machine-verifiable evaluation of mathematical reasoning, yet existing benchmarks often emphasize aggregate proof accuracy, concentrate on a narrow range of mathematics, and provide limited evidence of robustness to equivalent reformulations. We introduce MathAdv, a diagnostic benchmark spanning 13 domains across undergraduate- and graduate-level mathematics. Alongside Lean 4 theorem proving, MathAdv provides up to three auxiliary tasks: multiple-choice questions that probe mathematical knowledge, fill-in-the-blank problems that isolate informal reasoning, and expert-crafted transformations that test robustness to problem presentation. Our evaluation of contemporary theorem provers yields four findings: formalization remains a major bottleneck; performance varies substantially across mathematical domains; natural-language guidance helps general-purpose LLMs but can hinder proof-specialized models; and mathematically equivalent reformulations expose substantial robustness limitations. Together, these results show how component-wise evaluation can reveal model capabilities and failure modes that aggregate theorem-proving accuracy obscures. The dataset and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/margotyjx/MathAdv.git.
articles.titleCn: MathAdv：证明器知道、推理、形式化和推广什么定理
articles.abstractCn: 形式化定理证明能够实现机器可验证的数学推理评估，但现有的基准测试往往侧重于整体证明准确率，专注于狭窄的数学范围，并提供有限的证据来证明对等价重述的鲁棒性。我们引入了MathAdv，一个涵盖本科和研究生数学13个领域的诊断基准。除了Lean 4定理证明外，MathAdv还提供最多三个辅助任务：测试数学知识的选择题、隔离非正式推理的填空题，以及由专家设计的测试问题呈现鲁棒性的转换。我们对当代定理证明器的评估得出了四点发现：形式化仍然是一个主要的瓶颈；性能在不同数学领域之间存在显著差异；自然语言指导有助于通用大型语言模型，但可能阻碍专门用于证明的模型；数学上等价的重新表述暴露了显著的鲁棒性限制。这些结果共同表明，组件式评估可以揭示模型能力和失效模式，而这些模式被整体定理证明准确率所掩盖。数据集和评估脚本可在https://github.com/margotyjx/MathAdv.git获取。

articles.title: DCGC: Draft-Conditioned Global Correction for Complex Reasoning with Masked Diffusion Models
articles.abstract: Correcting flawed reasoning traces remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs), whose autoregressive generation can propagate early mistakes into subsequent reasoning. We introduce DCGC, a Masked Diffusion Model (MDM) framework for global correction that uses an imperfect solution draft from an upstream solver as auxiliary context. DCGC combines task-specific Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with a novel inference-time mechanism called Dynamic Dual-CFG. This mechanism separates problem-only and joint problem-draft branches and scales the draft-conditioned residual using a relative confidence gap. Across math, code, and knowledge reasoning benchmarks, DCGC outperforms standard sampling and simpler CFG variants, with additional results suggesting transfer to different diffusion backbones. In test-time setting where ground-truth failure labels are unavailable, DCGC improves full test set accuracy by correcting low-consensus upstream outputs, highlighting its utility as a verifier-free global correction module for difficult reasoning instances.
articles.titleCn: DCGC：用于复杂推理的掩码扩散模型的草稿条件全局校正
articles.abstractCn: 纠正有缺陷的推理轨迹仍然是大型语言模型（LLMs）的一项重大挑战，其自回归生成过程会将早期的错误传播到后续的推理中。我们引入了DCGC，这是一个用于全局校正的掩码扩散模型（MDM）框架，它使用上游求解器提供的不完美解决方案草稿作为辅助上下文。DCGC结合了特定任务的监督微调（SFT）以及一种称为动态双CFG的新型推理时机制。该机制将仅问题分支和联合问题-草稿分支分离，并使用相对置信度差距对草稿条件残差进行缩放。在数学、代码和知识推理基准测试中，DCGC优于标准采样和更简单的CFG变体，此外的结果还表明可以迁移到不同的扩散主干。在测试时设置中，当无法获得真实失败标签时，DCGC通过纠正低共识的上游输出，提高了完整测试集的准确率，突显了其作为无需验证器的全局校正模块在处理困难推理实例方面的实用性。

articles.title: OmniPhys: A Unified Multimodal Benchmark for Physics Understanding and Generation from Chinese Educational Corpora
articles.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong abilities in solving diverse visual and textual reasoning tasks. However, their development in the physics domain is significantly hindered by the lack of a comprehensive benchmark. To fill this gap, we introduce OmniPhys, a large-scale benchmark for multimodal physics understanding and reasoning, covering middle school through university-level problems from Chinese Educational Corpora. OmniPhys consists of 15,246 questions and 19,850 images, accompanied by detailed annotations that support fine-grained analysis of reasoning processes and knowledge usage. Beyond conventional evaluation, OmniPhys is a benchmark that systematically evaluates multimodal outputs in the physics domain, including models' ability to generate structured physics diagrams, which constitute a fundamental component of authentic physics problem solving. Extensive evaluations reveal critical gaps in the capabilities of current MLLMs, especially in complex reasoning and visual generation. To address this, we release OmniPhys to serve as a foundational resource for advancing multimodal intelligence in physics and scientific domains. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/ECNU-RAIL/OmniPhys-EMNLP2026.
articles.titleCn: OmniPhys：一个基于中文教育语料库的物理理解与生成统一多模态基准
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在解决多样化的视觉和文本推理任务中展现出强大的能力。然而，它们在物理领域的开发受到缺乏全面基准的显著阻碍。为填补这一空白，我们引入了OmniPhys，一个大规模的多模态物理理解和推理基准，涵盖了从中学到大学水平的中文教育语料库问题。OmniPhys包含15,246个问题和19,850张图像，并配有详细的标注，支持对推理过程和知识使用的细粒度分析。除了传统的评估之外，OmniPhys是一个系统地评估物理领域多模态输出的基准，包括模型生成结构化物理图的能力，而物理图是真实物理问题解决的基本组成部分。广泛的评估揭示了当前MLLMs在复杂推理和视觉生成方面的关键能力差距。为此，我们发布OmniPhys，作为推进物理和科学领域多模态智能发展的基础资源。代码和数据可在https://github.com/ECNU-RAIL/OmniPhys-EMNLP2026获取。

articles.title: Adaptive Triggering for Bias Correction in LLM Reasoning
articles.abstract: Chain-of-thought prompting can expose and amplify demographic stereotypes within an LLM's intermediate reasoning and create a failure mode that final-answer debiasing alone cannot address. Mitigating such bias during generation presents a fundamental timing problem: intervening too late allows biased reasoning to propagate, while unnecessarily intervening can disrupt otherwise correct reasoning. Existing approaches largely avoid this decision by either evaluating completed reasoning chains post hoc or intervening at predetermined steps, leaving open when a developing reasoning trajectory provides sufficient evidence to warrant correction. We formulate this decision as an online change-point detection problem. A per-step bias signal updates a CUSUM statistic and a targeted correction is injected only when accumulated evidence crosses a detector-specific threshold calibrated on held-out data. We instantiate the framework with a white-box signal derived from next-token probabilities and a black-box signal obtained from an LLM judge, enabling deployment with both open-weight and hosted models. On gpt-4o-mini adaptive black-box triggering recovers most of the disambiguated-context accuracy lost under fixed-interval intervention while requiring substantially fewer interventions. That result holds even with an independent judge. Across six open-weight models, the white-box signal improves ambiguous-item accuracy on all six but reduces disambiguated-item accuracy on five because it cannot distinguish unsupported stereotype reliance from correct, stereotype-congruent evidence.
articles.titleCn: 用于LLM推理的偏差校正的自适应触发
articles.abstractCn: 思维链提示可能会暴露并放大大型语言模型中间推理过程中的群体刻板印象，从而产生仅靠最终答案去偏方法无法解决的失效模式。在生成过程中缓解此类偏见存在一个根本性的时间问题：干预过晚会导致偏见推理扩散，而无需干预则会扰乱原本正确的推理。现有方法主要通过事后评估完成的推理链或预设步骤进行干预来回避这一决策，留下了当推理轨迹发展提供足够证据时是否需要纠正的疑问。我们将这一决策问题形式化为在线变化点检测问题。每一步的偏见信号会更新一个累积和统计量，只有当累积证据超过针对特定检测器校准的、基于保留数据的阈值时，才会注入目标纠正。我们用从下一词概率导出的白盒信号和从大型语言模型裁判者获得的黑盒信号实例化该框架，使其能够与开放权重和托管模型部署。在gpt-4o-mini自适应黑盒触发下，该方法恢复了在固定间隔干预下丢失的大部分消歧上下文准确率，同时显著减少了干预次数。这一结果即使使用独立裁判者也同样成立。在六个开放权重模型中，白盒信号在所有六个模型上提高了模糊项准确率，但在五个模型上降低了消歧项准确率，因为它无法区分不受支持的刻板印象依赖与正确的、符合刻板印象的证据。

articles.title: GGSS: Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering for Inference-Time Debiasing of Generative Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Generative vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in human-centered settings, yet they can produce demographically biased outputs even when images differ only in controlled attributes such as perceived race or gender. However, existing inference-time debiasers were largely designed for static embeddings or CLIP-like models rather than generative VLMs. We propose GGSS---Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering---a norm-preserving intervention that discovers a counterfactual bias subspace on the unit hypersphere, steers visual tokens along geodesic arcs, and uses an adaptive gate to focus correction on tokens that carry stronger demographic signal. We evaluate four generative VLMs against ten adapted inference-time debiasing baselines and prompt-based mitigation under a single operating-point protocol across categorical, pairwise, and occupation-gender bias tests, while also measuring general visual-language capability. GGSS achieves the lowest average bias on all four models, significant on three of four backbones under paired permutation tests, while preserving MMStar accuracy within +/- 0.6 p.p. of the unsteered baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/dukesun99/GGSS.
articles.titleCn: GGSS：用于生成式视觉语言模型推理时去偏的测地线门控球形转向
articles.abstractCn: 生成式视觉语言模型（VLMs）在以人为中心的场景中应用日益广泛，但即使图像仅在感知种族或性别等受控属性上存在差异，它们仍可能产生人口统计偏差的输出。然而，现有的推理时去偏方法主要针对静态嵌入或CLIP类模型，而非生成式VLMs。我们提出了GGSS——地测门控球面引导——一种保持范数的干预方法，该方法在单位超球面上发现反事实偏差子空间，引导视觉标记沿测地线弧移动，并使用自适应门来将校正集中在携带更强人口统计信号的标记上。我们在单一操作点协议下，针对分类、成对和职业-性别偏差测试，评估了四种生成式VLMs与十种适配的推理时去偏基线以及基于提示的缓解措施，同时测量了通用视觉语言能力。GGSS在所有四种模型上实现了最低的平均偏差，在三种成对置换测试中显著降低偏差，同时将MMStar准确率保持在未引导基线的±0.6个百分点的范围内。代码可在https://github.com/dukesun99/GGSS获取。

articles.title: Leveraging Speech Acts for Low-Data and Cross-Domain Conversation Derailment Forecasting
articles.abstract: Conversational derailment forecasting aims to predict when online discussions will escalate into hostility, enabling proactive moderation. Existing approaches often struggle in low-data settings and to generalize across domains. This poses a challenge for new platforms and smaller communities where annotated data is limited. We propose modeling pragmatic representations of conversations to reduce lexical noise and improve generalizability. Specifically, speech act information is used as an auxiliary learning signal alongside textual semantics. Experimental results show improved performance across three datasets, particularly in low-data and cross-domain settings.
articles.titleCn: 利用言语行为进行低数据和跨领域对话偏离预测
articles.abstractCn: 对话偏离预测旨在预测在线讨论何时会升级为敌意，从而实现主动管理。现有方法在低数据场景和跨领域泛化方面往往存在困难。这对新平台和规模较小的社区构成挑战，因为标注数据有限。我们提出对对话的语用表示进行建模，以减少词汇噪声并提高泛化能力。具体而言，将言语行为信息作为文本语义的辅助学习信号。实验结果表明，在三个数据集上性能得到提升，尤其是在低数据和跨领域场景中。

articles.title: Escaping Low-Dimensional Overlap: Multi-Task Model Merging via High-Dimensional Sparse Disentanglement
articles.abstract: Model merging provides an efficient way to construct multi-task generalist models without additional training, but its performance often degrades under severe task interference. Task interference in model merging primarily stems from \textit{superposition}, where task-specific features become entangled within the parameter space. This entanglement renders conventional decomposition methods insufficient for effectively isolating useful task directions from interfering components. In this paper, we propose a sparse-representation-based merging framework that uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to project task vectors into a high-dimensional sparse feature space, enabling feature-level disentanglement before fusion. To reduce computational overhead, we further introduce a lightweight Group-Ranked Zeroth-Order Optimizer (GR-ZOO) to identify task-critical layers for selective merging. Experiments on both Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms representative baselines, including Task Arithmetic, TIES-Merge, DARE, Fisher-Merge,and several recent training-free merging methods, across mathematical reasoning, code generation, instruction following, and general knowledge tasks. In a highly conflicting four-task setting on Qwen2.5-1.5B, our method further achieves a 2.78\% improvement over the strongest baseline.
articles.titleCn: 摆脱低维重叠：通过高维稀疏解耦进行多任务模型合并
articles.abstractCn: 模型融合为在不进行额外训练的情况下构建多任务通用模型提供了一种高效方法，但在严重任务干扰下其性能往往会下降。模型融合中的任务干扰主要源于\textit{叠加效应}，即特定任务的特性在参数空间中变得纠缠在一起。这种纠缠使得传统的分解方法不足以有效地从干扰成分中分离出有用的任务方向。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于稀疏表示的融合框架，该框架使用稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）将任务向量投影到高维稀疏特征空间，从而在融合前实现特征级别的解纠缠。为了降低计算开销，我们进一步引入了一种轻量级的组排序零阶优化器（GR-ZOO），用于识别任务关键层进行选择性融合。在Qwen2.5-1.5B和Qwen2.5-7B上的实验表明，我们的方法在数学推理、代码生成、指令跟随和一般知识任务上始终优于代表性基线，包括任务算术、TIES-Merge、DARE、Fisher-Merge以及几种近期的无训练融合方法。在Qwen2.5-1.5B上高度冲突的四任务设置中，我们的方法进一步比最强基线提升了2.78%。

articles.title: Short Horizons and Sparse Concepts: a Mathematical View of the Readout in the J-lens
articles.abstract: The Jacobian lens (J-lens) has been proposed as a way to read verbalizable representations from language models. However, its principle and meaning lack a detailed and theoretical discussion. We provide a mathematical view of this interpretation and of its assumed causal structure. Besides treating the J-lens as a heuristic probe, we further regard it as a first-order causal transfer operator from intermediate activations to expected future readouts. We study the Jacobian matrix as the optimal local linear approximation of the downstream mapping, analyze its global approximation behavior and bias, and identify its mathematical meaning as an expectation over anticipated future readouts. Further analysis of the Jacobian energy distribution reveals that its causal geometry is highly sparse. The energy decays with depth, concentrates in an extremely small proportion, and decomposes into diagonal pathways and specific critical positions. This decomposition further resolves the expectation of the J-lens over future outputs into short-horizon and sparse concept predictions, providing a more intuitive attribution and explanation for the ability of the J-lens to visualize concepts during the thinking process. Based on the theory, we propose a simple but effective improvement strategy and decoupling method for the J-lens, which significantly enhances the ability of the J-lens to read out correct intermediate concepts.
articles.titleCn: 短期视野与稀疏概念：J透镜读数的数学视角
articles.abstractCn: 雅可比透镜（J-lens）已被提出作为一种从语言模型中读取可言语化表示的方法。然而，其原理和意义缺乏详细和理论上的讨论。我们提供了这种解释及其假设因果结构的数学视角。除了将J-lens视为一种启发式探针外，我们还进一步将其视为一种从中间激活到预期未来读数的首阶因果传递算子。我们研究雅可比矩阵作为下游映射的最优局部线性近似，分析其全局近似行为和偏差，并确定其数学意义为对未来预期读数的期望。进一步分析雅可比能量分布揭示，其因果几何结构高度稀疏。能量随深度衰减，集中在一个极小的比例内，并分解为对角路径和特定的临界位置。这种分解进一步将J-lens对未来输出的期望分解为短期和稀疏概念预测，为J-lens在思考过程中可视化概念的能力提供了更直观的归因和解释。基于该理论，我们提出了一种简单但有效的改进策略和解耦方法，显著增强了J-lens读取正确中间概念的能力。

articles.title: GUIDE: Generative Unsupervised Chinese Query Correction via Phonetic and Visual Shared-ID Encoding
articles.abstract: Chinese query correction (CQC) is important for search and query recommendation on content platforms, but supervised methods rely on large annotated correction pairs that are costly to maintain as query vocabularies evolve. Unsupervised correction with language models is attractive, yet in the short-query setting, unconstrained generation often over-corrects ambiguous inputs toward high-frequency phrases, causing intent drift. We propose \textsc{GUIDE}, a generative unsupervised framework for CQC based on a confuse-then-clarify paradigm. \textsc{GUIDE} encodes phonetically or visually confusable characters with shared-IDs and reconstructs the original query with an encoder--decoder architecture, which constrains correction to plausible confusion neighborhoods while learning from unlabeled query streams. A time-decayed, query-frequency-weighted objective further supports adaptation to rapidly changing query vocabularies. Experiments on \textit{QSpell 250K} and a large-scale real-world dataset (\textit{KwaiSearch}) show that \textsc{GUIDE} consistently outperforms strong baselines, while online A/B testing further confirms gains in correction quality and downstream engagement.

articles.titleCn: 指南：基于语音和视觉共享ID编码的生成式无监督中文查询纠正
articles.abstractCn: 中文查询纠正（CQC）对于内容平台上的搜索和查询推荐至关重要，但监督方法依赖于大量标注的纠正对，而查询词汇的演变使得这些对的高成本维护成为难题。基于语言模型的非监督纠正方法具有吸引力，但在短查询场景中，无约束生成往往会对模糊输入过度纠正为高频短语，导致意图漂移。我们提出了 \textsc{GUIDE}，这是一种基于混淆-澄清范式的生成式非监督 CQC 框架。 \textsc{GUIDE} 通过共享 ID 对语音或视觉上易混淆的字符进行编码，并使用编码器-解码器架构重建原始查询，从而将纠正约束在合理的混淆邻域内，同时从无标签查询流中学习。一个时间衰减、查询频率加权的目标进一步支持了对快速变化的查询词汇表的适应。在 \textit{QSpell 250K} 和一个大规模真实世界数据集（\textit{KwaiSearch}）上的实验表明，\textsc{GUIDE} 始终优于强大的基线，而在线 A/B 测试进一步证实了纠正质量和下游参与度的提升。

articles.title: Provenance Before Prose: Claim-Locked Reporting
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can fluently verbalize statistical evidence, yet statistical reports can still drift numerical values, invert effect directions, or restate thresholded contrasts as categorical effects. We frame these failures as a control problem: the evidence-bearing content of a scientific report should be fixed by structured statistical results rather than sampled during prose generation. We therefore use cross-run reproducibility to stress-test whether report-visible numbers and claims are bound before prose generation. Existing controls operate at the text or slot level; a deterministic hybrid template reproduces only 61.1% of report-visible numerical content across seeds because the LLM still selects which findings and numbers the template renders. We propose claim-locked reporting, a provenance-before-prose protocol that fixes the evidence source, numbers, direction, and allowed language strength of each reportable claim before the LLM writes only connective prose. Across fMRI functional-connectivity reporting and randomized controlled trial reporting on Evidence Inference 2.0, claim-locked reporting improves reproducibility over the hybrid template by 37.4 and 20.5 points, respectively. Blinded human audits support the observed direction-preservation and governance trends. In an fMRI cost analysis with DeepSeek, claim-locked reporting also yields the lowest observed token use and median generation latency.
articles.titleCn: 在散文之前确立来源：声明锁定报告
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够流畅地表述统计证据，但统计报告仍可能漂移数值、反转效应方向，或将阈值对比重新表述为分类效应。我们将这些错误视为控制问题：科学报告的证据承载内容应由结构化的统计结果固定，而非在文本生成过程中采样。因此，我们使用跨运行可重复性来测试报告可见的数字和主张是否在文本生成前已被绑定。现有的控制方法在文本或槽位级别操作；一个确定性混合模板在种子间仅能复现61.1%的报告可见数值内容，因为LLM仍选择要渲染的发现和数值。我们提出了声明锁定报告，这是一种源代码先于文本的协议，它在LLM仅生成连接性文本之前，固定了每个可报告声明的证据来源、数值、方向和允许的语言强度。在fMRI功能连接报告和Evidence Inference 2.0的随机对照试验报告中，声明锁定报告分别比混合模板提高了37.4和20.5点的可重复性。盲法人工审核支持了观察到的方向保留和治理趋势。在与DeepSeek进行的fMRI成本分析中，声明锁定报告还产生了最低的观测token使用量和中位数生成延迟。

articles.title: Learning What to Share and What to Personalize: Hierarchical Strategy Co-Evolution for Agent Memory
articles.abstract: Memory-augmented agents maintain compact user profiles throughout extended conversations, enabling personalized and consistent responses without the need to process the entire dialogue history. The quality of these user profiles relies on the underlying memory management strategy: at each step, the agent must determine what to retain, compress, or discard. However, existing methods typically employ a static, one-size-fits-all strategy established before training. In practice, the optimal memory decision is inherently user-specific and dynamically evolves alongside policy optimization. To address this, we propose \textbf{HiPS} (\textbf{Hi}erarchical \textbf{P}ersonalized \textbf{S}trategy), a framework that decouples memory management into a globally shared foundation and a user-specific adaptive tier. Specifically, HiPS employs \textbf{Universal Strategy} to extract shared principles from cross-persona trajectories, alongside \textbf{Persona Delta Distillation} to generate tailored rules for users whose behaviors diverge from general patterns. \textbf{Cross-Level Rule Flow} dynamically calibrates their boundary by promoting broadly validated personal rules and demoting contradicted global ones. The architecture establishes a co-evolution loop where a mechanism guarantees that all strategy refinements are anchored to task outcomes. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over memory-augmented baselines.
articles.titleCn: 学习分享什么与个性化什么：智能体记忆的层次策略协同进化
articles.abstractCn: 记忆增强代理在长时间对话中维持紧凑的用户画像，从而无需处理整个对话历史即可实现个性化和一致的响应。这些用户画像的质量依赖于底层的记忆管理策略：在每一步，代理必须决定要保留、压缩还是丢弃哪些内容。然而，现有方法通常采用在训练前建立的一种静态的、一刀切的策略。在实践中，最优的记忆决策本质上具有用户特定性，并随着策略优化动态演变。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 \textbf{HiPS} (\textbf{Hi}erarchical \textbf{P}ersonalized \textbf{S}trategy)，一个将记忆管理解耦为全局共享基础和用户特定自适应层级的框架。具体而言，HiPS 采用 \textbf{Universal Strategy} 从跨角色轨迹中提取共享原则，并通过 \textbf{Persona Delta Distillation} 为行为偏离一般模式用户提供定制规则。 \textbf{Cross-Level Rule Flow} 通过推广广泛验证的个性化规则并贬低被反驳的全局规则来动态校准其边界。该架构建立了一个协同进化循环，其中机制保证所有策略优化都锚定于任务结果。大量实验表明，与记忆增强基线相比，HiPS 始终如一地实现了改进。

articles.title: FinRiskAtlas: Decision-Aligned Evaluation of Large Language Models for Financial Risk Review
articles.abstract: Deploying large language models for professional financial review requires more than measuring general financial competence: models must perform the specific review operation required by a workflow and determine whether available evidence is sufficient for a defensible decision. Existing financial benchmarks cover knowledge, reasoning, compliance, and professional tasks, but their evaluation units are often organized around datasets or task formulations rather than the decisions that deployed systems support. We introduce FinRiskAtlas, a Chinese-language benchmark that evaluates financial LLMs along two complementary dimensions: operation execution under fixed evidence states and evidence-state control under evolving review conditions. The static benchmark contains 9,742 instances across 53 task families, including 42 Domain Knowledge families and eleven downstream review operations defined by explicit evaluation contracts. FinRisk-Ask extends this framework through offline replay of 680 pre-action states from 104 de-identified professional trajectories, withholding future evidence during inference and using it only to construct expert-verified evidence targets. Across 33 model configurations, operation-level evaluation yields non-redundant rankings (mean pairwise Spearman correlation 0.42 across downstream operations), and knowledge-based shortlisting can incur up to 18.01 points of regret on individual operations. FinRisk-Ask further shows that entering the Ask branch more frequently does not necessarily improve request targeting or end-to-end evidence acquisition. These results show that broad financial capability scores do not fully capture where models are reliable in professional workflows, motivating evaluation units aligned with the decisions and evidence states that deployed systems must support.
articles.titleCn: FinRiskAtlas：用于金融风险审查的大型语言模型的决策对齐评估
articles.abstractCn: 在专业金融审核中部署大型语言模型，不仅需要衡量一般金融能力，模型还必须执行工作流程所需的特定审核操作，并判断现有证据是否足以支持可辩护的决策。现有的金融基准涵盖了知识、推理、合规性和专业任务，但它们的评估单元通常围绕数据集或任务公式组织，而不是部署系统支持的决定。我们介绍了FinRiskAtlas，一个中文语言基准，它沿两个互补维度评估金融LLM：在固定证据状态下执行操作，以及在变化的审核条件下控制证据状态。静态基准包含53个任务家族中的9,742个实例，包括42个领域知识家族和由明确评估合同定义的十一个下游审核操作。FinRisk-Ask通过离线重放104个去识别化专业轨迹中的680个预行动状态来扩展这一框架，在推理过程中隐藏未来证据，仅用于构建专家验证的证据目标。在33个模型配置中，操作级评估产生了非冗余排名（下游操作间平均成对Spearman相关系数为0.42），基于知识的筛选可能导致单个操作高达18.01点的后悔。FinRisk-Ask进一步表明，更频繁地进入Ask分支并不一定能够提高请求定位或端到端证据获取。这些结果表明，广泛的金融能力评分并不能完全捕捉模型在专业工作流程中的可靠性，从而推动评估单元与部署系统必须支持的决定和证据状态相一致。

articles.title: Routed Graph Handoff: Adaptive Format Selection for Multi-Agent LLM Delegation
articles.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems coordinate through natural-language messages that consume 40--60\% of their token budget. Replacing these with structured graphs reduces cost but fails on tasks requiring adaptive reasoning. We propose \textbf{Routed Graph Handoff}, where a lightweight LLM router (155 tokens, 0.15\% overhead) selects between a typed dependency graph and natural language for each delegation. On four benchmarks (1,050+ trajectories), the routed system matches or exceeds NL-only on every task: \textbf{+12.7\,pp} on $τ$-retail at 3.2$\times$ compression ($p{<}0.01$), \textbf{+8.7\,pp} on BrowseComp at 2.2$\times$ compression ($p{<}0.05$), and parity on BFCL and AppWorld. Without the router, graph-only delegation regresses 14.6\,pp on AppWorld; the router eliminates this at near-zero cost. A graph-aware executor prompt is required: the same schema without interpretation guidance yields no gain. An oracle analysis reveals 8.6\,pp of additional headroom, motivating execution-time adaptive routing as future work.
articles.titleCn: 路由图切换：多智能体LLM委托的自适应格式选择
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体LLM系统通过自然语言消息进行协调，这些消息占用了它们40--60%的token预算。用结构化图来替代这些消息可以降低成本，但在需要自适应推理的任务上会失败。我们提出了\textbf{路由图交接}方案，其中轻量级的LLM路由器（155个token，0.15%的开销）为每次委托选择类型依赖图或自然语言。在四个基准测试（1,050+条轨迹）中，路由系统在所有任务上都达到了或超过了仅使用自然语言的水平：在$τ$-retail任务上提升了\textbf{+12.7\,pp}，压缩比为3.2倍（$p{<}0.01$）；在BrowseComp任务上提升了\textbf{+8.7\,pp}，压缩比为2.2倍（$p{<}0.05$）；在BFCL和AppWorld任务上达到了同等水平。如果没有路由器，仅使用图的委托在AppWorld任务上会下降14.6\,pp；而路由器以近乎零成本消除了这一问题。需要一种图感知的执行器提示：相同的模式如果没有解释指导将不会带来收益。神谕分析揭示了8.6\,pp的额外空间，为未来执行时自适应路由的研究提供了动力。

articles.title: Groundhog Bit-Flip Attack: Seeding Infinite Generation Loops in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs through Bit Flips
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enable scalable and efficient large language models (LLMs) by selectively activating expert sub-networks through a routing mechanism. However, this adaptive design introduces a new attack surface: specific experts become disproportionately correlated with certain tokens (e.g., end-of-sequence), allowing adversaries to manipulate model behavior via lightweight perturbations. In this work, we present \textbf{Groundhog Bit-Flip Attack (GBFA)}, the first bit-flip-based \textit{ Denial-of-Wallet availability attack} against MoE-based LLMs. By identifying and flipping routing-layer bits associated with related expert activations, we demonstrate that GBFA substantially extends the decoding token usage across three different LLM modes: conversational, reasoning, and agentic tasks, while largely preserving semantic fidelity. Across four main real-world MoE-based LLMs, manually deactivating on average fewer than \textbf{4 experts} drives average output inflation to $\mathbf{5912\%}$, with the majority of test samples reaching max tokens. These results reveal a robustness vulnerability of MoE architectures to bit flip, and highlight the potential of GBFA as an availability attack against LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 地鼠翻转攻击：通过位翻转在专家混合大型语言模型中植入无限生成循环
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）架构通过路由机制选择性地激活专家子网络，从而实现可扩展且高效的巨型语言模型（LLM）。然而，这种自适应设计引入了一个新的攻击面：特定专家与某些标记（例如序列结束标记）之间存在不成比例的相关性，使攻击者能够通过轻量级扰动来操纵模型行为。在这项工作中，我们提出了基于比特翻转的首次针对基于MoE的LLM的可用性拒绝攻击——\textbf{地鼠比特翻转攻击（GBFA）}。通过识别并翻转与相关专家激活相关的路由层比特，我们证明GBFA能够显著扩展解码标记使用量，涵盖对话、推理和代理任务三种不同的LLM模式，同时基本保持语义保真度。在四个主要的基于MoE的LLM上，手动禁用平均少于\textbf{4个专家}即可将平均输出膨胀至\mathbf{5912\%}，多数测试样本达到最大标记数。这些结果表明MoE架构对比特翻转存在稳健性漏洞，并突显了GBFA作为针对LLM可用性攻击的潜力。

articles.title: The "Curse of Knowledge" in LLM Query Simulation: Concept Provenance for Tracing Answer-Side Intrusion
articles.abstract: LLM-generated search queries are widely used to augment IR evaluation, yet they may contain concepts that presuppose answer-side document knowledge, violating the information-access boundary of pre-search users. Existing validation metrics, including overlap, diversity, and effectiveness, cannot distinguish rare human-tail variation from candidate answer-side intrusion. We introduce concept provenance, a framework that assigns query concepts to backstory-supported, human-central, human-tail, and candidate answer-side zones, operationalizing a boundary that retrieval metrics alone cannot detect. Applying concept provenance to 77,004 queries across 100 UQV100 topics, 8 LLMs, and 5 prompt conditions with two extraction pipelines, we obtain a cross-pipeline token-HCIR Spearman rho of 1.0 over five condition means. Candidate answer-side concepts constitute 7.40 percent of non-generic concepts and appear in 97 of 100 topics, with topic explaining approximately 67 percent of variance. Human validation yields 68.2 percent relaxed precision, revealing two mechanisms: knowledge intrusion at 45.5 percent and deployment intrusion at 45.0 percent. Diagnostic probes show disproportionate localized retrieval effects, with deletion effect size d = -0.47 compared with d = -0.34 for random deletion, but these concepts explain less than 2 percent of aggregate evaluation variance. Concept provenance therefore serves as a boundary-compliance diagnostic rather than an evaluation-shift predictor. Under the tested conditions, no prompt condition eliminates intrusion; post-generation concept-provenance selection achieves 99 percent elimination.

articles.titleCn: LLM查询模拟中的“知识诅咒”：追踪答案端入侵的概念溯源
articles.abstractCn: LLM生成的搜索查询被广泛用于增强信息检索评估，但它们可能包含预设答案端文档知识的概念，违反了预搜索用户的信息获取边界。现有的验证指标，包括重叠度、多样性和有效性，无法区分罕见的人类尾部变化与候选答案端的入侵。我们引入了概念来源，这是一个将查询概念分配到背景故事支持、人类中心、人类尾部和候选答案端的框架，实现了一个仅靠检索指标无法检测的边界。将概念来源应用于77,004个查询，涵盖100个UQV100主题、8个LLM和5种提示条件，以及两种提取流程，我们获得了跨流程的token-HCIR斯皮尔曼ρ为1.0，在五种条件平均值上。候选答案端的概念占非通用概念的7.40%，出现在100个主题中的97个，主题解释了约67%的方差。人类验证产生了68.2%的放宽精确度，揭示了两种机制：知识入侵占45.5%，部署入侵占45.0%。诊断探针显示出不成比例的局部检索效应，删除效应大小d = -0.47，与随机删除的d = -0.34相比，但这些概念解释了不到2%的总评估方差。因此，概念来源作为边界合规性诊断工具，而非评估转移预测器。在测试条件下，没有提示条件能消除入侵；生成后的概念来源选择实现了99%的消除。

articles.title: From Memorization to Absorption: Mixed-Policy RL for Continual Knowledge Injection
articles.abstract: Continual knowledge injection is essential for keeping large language models up-to-date in a fast-evolving world. Existing methods rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which memorizes injected facts in their training format but fails to generalize across paraphrasing, document combinations, and reasoning. To address this, we propose Golden-GRPO Injection (GRIN), a three-stage self-learning framework for continual knowledge injection. Golden-GRPO is a mixed-policy reinforcement learning algorithm designed specifically for knowledge injection, which injects a golden answer to provide learning signal even when on-policy rollouts fail on novel facts. We further introduce Blank and Counter, two document-level benchmarks targeting novel acquisition and counterfactual overwrite respectively, each evaluating single-fact recall, multi-source retrieval, and inferential reasoning. Our experiments establish a clear empirical claim: mixed-policy reinforcement learning enables knowledge absorption beyond what supervised fine-tuning can achieve. GRIN substantially outperforms SFT and mixed-policy RL baselines on the harder question types while matching them on basic fact recall.
articles.titleCn: 从记忆到内化：混合策略强化学习用于持续知识注入
articles.abstractCn: 持续知识注入对于在快速发展的世界中保持大型语言模型的更新至关重要。现有方法依赖于监督微调（SFT），该方法在训练格式中记忆注入的事实，但无法泛化到释义、文档组合和推理中。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了黄金策略强化学习算法注入（GRIN），这是一个用于持续知识注入的三阶段自学习框架。黄金策略强化学习算法是一种专门为知识注入设计的混合策略强化学习算法，它注入黄金答案，即使在策略执行过程中对新生成的事实失败时也能提供学习信号。我们进一步引入了空白和反事实，两个文档级别的基准，分别针对新知识获取和反事实覆盖，每个基准评估单事实召回、多源检索和推理能力。我们的实验确立了一个明确的实证主张：混合策略强化学习能够实现超越监督微调的知识吸收。GRIN在更难的问题类型上显著优于SFT和混合策略RL基线，同时在基本事实召回上与它们持平。
